page.layout: One printed page: a plate of coats of arms, with small captions above, between and below the shields. Top: a crest with a mitre and two labels, one left and one right. Then three rows of shields (three, three, three), a centred line of text between the first and second rows, and two further rows of shields below (two in the fourth, two in the bottom row). The small letter at the lower left stands alone.

main_text.l: S Dunelm. La Pokyngton. S.Cestren. W.Deuenom. S.Carlul. Ri Barnes.
S Eboracen. T.Yorpe. S.Bangor. R.Menek. S Landaph. A.Dunfrm.
S Circst. W.Barlowe. S Essen. W.Aleyn. S.Carlul. Io.Bell.

page.notes: No page number or running head printed. The plate shows heraldic shields: the top shield has a mitre-like crest with crossed keys and a fleur-de-lis pattern; the other shields carry charges such as keys, crosses, lions, birds, stars, a dove and a cross-hatched field. The captions are very small and worn, so many abbreviations and surnames are doubtful and should be read as [?]. The captions above the shields are transcribed as I could read them; the lower-left letter "D" may be a signature and is uncertain. The faint lines behind the shields are show-through from the reverse and are not transcribed.
